answer: Time keeps the wander, the ledger keeps the crystal, the toy shop keeps the karst; the farm keeps nothing but its printer. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. Farm 135 masks as a business and the ledger shows a single expense, 16605 POA locked away, and zero revenue. Every applicant faces the same trial, Hood maker sparrowhawk proof flown at the mews, and every verdict reads the same way: each sparrowhawk is a flight count weighed beside the maker's mark. An honest proof ages like good varnish; a farm proof cracks before the epoch ends.
